components.css: .ds-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid rgb(27 36 32 / .1);border-radius:6px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05)} @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){.ds-card{background:#18211c}} .ds-eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase} .ds-eyebrow::before{content:'';width:.3125rem;height:1em;background:#d9a13b} .ds-body{margin-top:.5rem;font:14px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif}

narrative.overview: A ballpark scoreboard that runs research: constant field-green structure, gold marking what matters now, monospace numerals wired like LED plates. Operate-mode density with brand in precise details.
keyCharacteristics: Field-green chrome + gold accents on paper/night surfaces
Barlow Condensed eyebrows with gold tick
IBM Plex Mono tabular numerals everywhere data appears
Flat ruled panels; hairlines over nested boxes
Evidence-first: color + marker + words for every graded signal

rules.name: The One Goodness Rule
rules.body: Graded stats: hot-red is good, cold-blue is bad, everywhere; lean strength alone speaks in grass/gold.

rules.name: The Deep-Twin Rule
rules.body: Bright accents for chips/ticks/fills/dark; -deep twins are the only small day-mode text form.

rules.name: Clay Means Broken
rules.body: Clay is reserved for failures — never scores, directions, or schedule facts.

rules.name: The Tick Rule
rules.body: No kicker above a heading; the gold-tick eyebrow heading stands alone.

rules.name: The Ruled-Panel Rule
rules.body: Group with spacing and hairlines; never nest bordered boxes inside bordered boxes.

dos: Do pair every graded color with its triangle marker and keep legends near tables
Do use -deep accent twins for small text on day surfaces
Do set all statistics in Plex Mono with tabular figures
donts: Don't rely on color alone for direction, score, or state
Don't put clay on anything that isn't a failure
Don't nest bordered boxes inside bordered boxes
Don't add a kicker above a heading
